title: Kerala High Court issues notice to ex-DGP Tomin Thachankary over continued use of official insignia
description: The Kerala High Court on Monday issued notice to former Director General of Police (DGP) Tomin J Thachankary on a petition over his continuing use the official 'Silver Star' DGP insignia on his private vehicle even after retiring from service [CT Muneer v State of Kerala & anr].Justice G Girish also directed the State to get instructions on the matter.Justice G Girish The petition was filed by activist CT Muneer challenging a May 14 order of the Judicial First Class Magistrate at Thamarasser
